key_insight: CREW replaces rigid multi-agent related-work pipelines with learned coordination, letting LLM agents dynamically choose actions to better synthesize scientific literature.
engineering_relevance: This framework suggests a more scalable and cost-aware design for agentic NLP systems that need adaptive collaboration rather than fixed task decomposition.
method: Multi-agent LLM framework for Automated Related Work Generation (RWG)
Agents autonomously select actions: Retrieve, Disseminate, Compose, and Critique
Action policy is optimized with Independent Proximal Policy Optimization (IPPO)
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on a standard RWG benchmark, showing substantial quality gains over strong baselines while reducing token costs.
watch_item: Performance may depend on stable reward design and training dynamics, since decentralized multi-agent RL with LLMs can be sensitive and harder to reproduce than fixed pipelines.
paper_title: Assembling the CREW: A Collaborative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning Framework for Automated Related Work Generation
